_comment: Radiance x0 patch-16 MULTI-GPU pipeline parallelism WITH weight streaming, LoRA. See radiance/train.py. Each GPU runs a slice of the block stack but holds only (window+pin) chunks of weights at a time — the rest live in pinned host RAM. That frees most of each GPU for activations, so this is the config to reach for when 'pipeline' OOMs at high resolution or batch size (with the NeRF head that happens sooner than in chroma). Pipelines barely touch PCIe (only activations cross stage boundaries), so weight streaming rides the idle bandwidth.
_comment_chunks: With 64 chunks over 4 GPUs each stage holds ~16 chunks and streams through 'offload_window' of them. offload_backward='keep' pairs with offload_activations (the activation packets then carry real internals); with 'checkpoint' the packets are just the chunk boundaries the engine caches anyway. offload_grad_accum='cpu' for LoRA-sized trainables.
_comment_batch: batch_size is PER MICROBATCH; effective batch = batch_size * n_microbatches.
_comment_ckpt: Path to the Radiance x0 patch-16 base weights (safetensors, native flow keys, 659 tensors). See checkpoints/README.md.
